source_read: the product pages on https://www.burgerking.co.uk/menu/picker-<id> (each has a 'Nutritional Information & Allergens' panel); robots.txt of burgerking.co.uk disallows only /bcc and /rewards/details
method: Independent second read in the founder's Chrome: each page's panel was opened and read with read_page on the dialog (exact text, not the first read's summaries). 5 rows from a random draw (seed 41) of data/source/burger-king, which also gave the Large Fries row from each panel.
result: 5 of 5 rows match on every number (kJ, kcal, carbohydrates, sugars, fat, saturates, protein, salt), and the 'Contains', 'May contain' and 'May contain via shared equipment' words agree with items.csv. This is BELOW the 15-row sample the playbook asks for (the site loads slowly and showed its own 'lost network connectivity' dialog after many page loads), so a longer re-read is still due for this chain.
